issue: One-shot outer_plaquettes iterable was consumed by incidence calculation before the radius calculation.
effect: Generator input could produce an incorrect disconnected radius=None and exact-zero bound.
stored_fixture_impact: Stored producer fixtures used reusable sets; numerical bound values were unaffected.
fix: Freeze support, inner_links and outer_plaquettes at bound_from_geometry entry.
regression: one_shot_geometry_iterators compares all-generator inputs against reusable sets and requires R=1 and a positive bound.
